display.purpose: One per viewport: wordmark now, money figures later.

shadows.name: slab-rise
shadows.purpose: Upward-cast structural shadow where a content slab rises over the committed field.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width filled action; the one primary move per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0E7C7B; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 14px; width: 100%; height: 52px; font: 600 16px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E7C7B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Filled neutral field with quiet stroke; validation speaks plainly.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FAFDFC; color: #191C1C; border: 1px solid #D4E0DF; border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; font: 400 16px Roboto, sans-serif; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0E7C7B; }

components.name: Capture FAB
components.description: The only ember element in the world: log an expense.
components.css: .ds-fab { background: #E8562A; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 16px; width: 56px; height: 56px; font-size: 24px; box-shadow: 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8562A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Honest placeholder: icon, title, what-arrives-and-when message.
components.html:
▦
Your month at a glance
Totals and budgets land here once expenses exist.
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 0 32px; } .ds-empty-icon { font-size: 48px; color: #899694; } .ds-empty-title { margin-top: 16px; font: 600 16px Roboto, sans-serif; color: #191C1C; } .ds-empty-body { margin-top: 8px; font: 400 14px Roboto, sans-serif; color: #404947; }

components.name: Rising Slab Sheet
components.description: Content surface rising over the committed field with the signature upward shadow.
components.css: .ds-slab { background: #FAFDFC; border-radius: 28px 28px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 -6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); padding: 32px 24px 24px; } .ds-slab-content { font: 400 14px Roboto, sans-serif; color: #191C1C; }

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Floating rounded toast for gentle status.
components.html: Expense capture arrives with the expenses release.
components.css: .ds-snackbar { background: #324948; color: #D5F1F0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; font: 400 14px Roboto, sans-serif; max-width: 420px; }

narrative.overview: Vault borrows the visual grammar of the mobile-wallet homes Egyptians already navigate daily — InstaPay, Vodafone Cash: a committed colored field owns whole regions of the screen, content arrives on floating off-white slabs, and exactly one hot accent exists, reserved by law for the capture action. Money is the protagonist; chrome stays quiet. Nothing nags, nothing glows.
keyCharacteristics: Two brand constants only: committed teal field, capture-only ember
All other color flows from Material role derivation (ColorScheme.fromSeed)
One typographic mass per viewport; type hierarchy does the rest quietly
Rounded-slab geometry (28px rising sheets, 14px controls, 12px toasts)

rules.name: The Ember Law
rules.body: Ember decorates only the capture action — currently the FAB, forever anything expense-capture becomes. If ember appears somewhere that cannot log an expense, the design is broken.

rules.name: The Committed Field Rule
rules.body: Whole regions carry the teal field; teal never shrinks to trim, borders, or small highlights. It commits area or abstains.

rules.name: The One Mass Rule
rules.body: Each viewport holds exactly one dominant typographic mass — the money figure or the wordmark — and every other string yields to it.

dos: Do derive every color except Field Teal and Ember from ColorScheme.fromSeed(fieldTeal) so dark theme adapts for free.
Do give each viewport exactly one monumental typographic mass.
Do write placeholders that name what arrives and when.
Do reserve 52px full-width filled buttons for a screen's single primary action.
donts: Don't use Ember anywhere that can't capture an expense — especially auth.
Don't hardcode neutrals; use scheme roles so dark mode stays coherent.
Don't shrink the teal into borders, badges, or trims — it commits regions or abstains.
Don't fake data states with skeletons or shimmers; say what's coming instead.
